en: The postcard depicts a vintage steam locomotive with the number '9005' on its front. The locomotive appears well-detailed, with visible wheels, pistons, and steam fittings. The background is plain, highlighting the engine as the central subject. The word 'BORSIG', which is associated with German locomotive manufacturing, is printed in the lower right corner. There are also some small numbers in the lower left corner ('A 2535'). The card is sepia-toned, giving it a historical or early 20th-century appearance.
